about_short_description.short_description: Pactima is an all-in-one eSignatures platform designed to meet every business needs.

product.name: Live eSignatures
product.description: Allows users to view and sign documents via a secure live video call with real-time collaboration and recording.

product.name: In-Person eSignatures
product.description: Enables signing of documents on any tablet without app downloads, supporting paperless workflows with audit trails and annotations.

product.name: Standard eSignatures
product.description: Facilitates sending documents via email for secure, asynchronous electronic signing with audit trails and team management.

product.name: Virtual Signing Network
product.description: Manages a network of custom signing rooms from a centralized location to enable secure remote signing across multiple sites.

product.name: Remote Online Notarization (RON)
product.description: Provides technology for notaries to perform legally compliant remote online notarizations with identity verification and session recording.

product.name: ID Verification
product.description: Offers multi-factor identity verification including biometric authentication and document verification to secure client validation.
